_note: Episode 45 (S5E4), story version 2 Kabanata 45: Mactan, Cebu, Bohol, Limasawa, Lake Lanao, the Sulu Sea over three nights; Usman present. Indio in his forties (string of Episodes 48 and 49) in the anting armour. Diwa are light only, no clear face, never a likeness. Tala and Tubal from Episode 46. Battle shown as shields of light, breaking smoke spears, arrows of light pinning shadows (unhurt): nobody is hit. The real 1521 and 1565 scenes are old-print or painted, far figures only. m_beside and cebu_treaty and sarimanok_art are montage extras. Narration cut (13 Nov ruling, narration_cuts.json): sentence 62 is left out of the narration, so its shot (fiction_card) is dropped and shots 63-67 move to 62-66; sentences.json keeps all 68 sentences, timings.json has 67.
